channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Half of Britain’s destroyer fleet now have power issue fixed
item.description: Three of the Royal Navy’s Type 45 destroyers have now completed the long-running Power Improvement Project (PIP) to resolve previous power generation problems. The post Half of Britain’s destroyer fleet now have power issue fixed first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American nuclear attack submarine arrives in Scotland
item.description: A Virginia-class nuclear submarine of the U.S. Navy has arrived in Scotland for a routine port visit. The post American nuclear attack submarine arrives in Scotland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: New British long range strike system ‘on track’
item.description: Written answers published this week confirm that Project Brakestop, the UK's effort to field a low-cost long-range one-way strike system, remains "broadly on track". The post New British long range strike system ‘on track’ first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain launches new Military Intelligence Services
item.description: The new Military Intelligence Services, or MIS, consolidates defence intelligence functions under one organisation for the first time. The post Britain launches new Military Intelligence Services first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: BAE Systems wins mega $1.7Bn U.S. Navy weapons contract
item.description: BAE Systems has been awarded a five year contract by the United States Navy for the continued production of APKWS laser guidance kits. The post BAE Systems wins mega $1.7Bn U.S. Navy weapons contract first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: SNP MSP says ‘foolish’ planning sank Ferguson Marine bid
item.description: An SNP MSP has publicly criticised Ferguson Marine’s former management in the Scottish Parliament, saying foolish decisions in a previous business plan left the state-owned yard uncompetitive and led to a failed vessel tender. The post SNP MSP says ‘foolish’ planning sank Ferguson Marine bid first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ministers ‘blindsided’ by offshore award of naval tug fleet
item.description: UK ministers were 'blindsided' by the offshore award of a 24-vessel naval support programme, Paul Sweeney MSP told us, after the procurement structure left them without direct oversight of the decision. The post Ministers ‘blindsided’ by offshore award of naval tug fleet first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American warship fires five inch main gun off Morroco
item.description: U.S. Navy destroyer USS Paul Ignatius has conducted a live firing of its Mk 45 five-inch gun during a naval surface fire support drill in the Atlantic Ocean, according to information released by the service. The post American warship fires five inch main gun off Morroco first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK developing urgent plan for conflict, minister says
item.description: The UK is drawing up new preparations for a potential major conflict, according to Armed Forces Minister Al Carns, in remarks reported by Sky News. The post UK developing urgent plan for conflict, minister says first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: The massive transformation underway at Babcock
item.description: Rosyth is going through a profound industrial shift. Digital engineering, early systems integration and lifetime control are redefining how warships are built and sustained. The change is structural, with implications far beyond a single programme. The post The massive transformation underway at Babcock first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
